Ordinance No. O-13 meeting Adopted 6/8/26 ATTACHED IS AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ARTICLE VI OF CHAPTER 6 OF THE SUPERIOR MUNICIPAL CODE. THIS AMENDMENT IS IN RESPONSE TO A NEW STATE LAW THAT REQUIRES LOCAL GOVERNMENTS TO ESTABLISH A BACKGROUND CHECK PROCESS FOR OWNERS AND EMPLOYEES OF MASSAGE FACILITIES. EACH FACILITY WILL BE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT BACKGROUND CHECK RESULTS TO THE TOWN. THE COST OF THE BACKGROUND CHECKS WILL BE THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THE MASSAGE FACILITY.
